terms.comment: Classically synthesis is a set of clothes or a loose dinner gown (Mart.).

phrases.latin: Theodōrus, synthesī dormītōriā etiamtum indūtus, in sellā altā sedēbat
phrases.english: Theo, still in his pyjamas, was sitting in his high chair
phrases.source: Fābula III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 117, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).
Theodōrus et pater: Fābulae Latīnae ad vītam cotīdiānam I–VII, as revised on 29 October 2026. Examples marked “Fābula” quote those texts word for word.
